professional quality protection.

# Welcome to our Online UK Fishing Tackle Store!

Whether you have just joined the world of fishing or have been angling for years, we share the same
love for this amazing pastime as you! That is why Angling Direct exists. We understand that fishing
is for all, without boundaries or restrictions, to purely enjoy the pursuit that angling offers.

That is why we want to help with **Getting Everyone Fishing.**

Here at Angling Direct, we are committed to providing you an incredible selection of the brands and
fishing tackle you love, fast and reliable delivery, and outstanding customer service. All whilst
giving the best price possible – With our **[Price Checker][286]**

We are here, for the Anglers

We have kept ahead of the game over the years by remaining constantly aware of the changing needs of
anglers, and we will continue to do so by always putting our customers' needs first.

Whether you are a beginner, novice, weekender, specialist, match winner, or syndicate member. We can
help you dream big with our fantastic selection of fishing tackle. Whatever your target species, or
ability and whether your fishing paradise is the beach, lake, canal, or river, you are in the right
hands with the UK’s No. 1 online fishing tackle shop!

We opened our first superstore back in 2004. We have since grown to provide [**Match & Coarse
Fishing**][287], [**Predator Fishing**][288], [**Specialist Fishing**][289], [**Fly Fishing**][290],
[**Sea Fishing**][291] tackle, and [**Carp Fishing**][292] tackle both in stores and online. Now,
you can shop for a variety of baits, fishing rods, fishing reels, fishing clothing, bait boats,
tackle boxes, fishing chairs, bite alarms, bed chairs for fishing, fishing lures, and more, all at
the most competitive prices.

Shop for Fishing Tackle In-Store!

Prefer to shop for your fishing gear in person or fancy a chat with our friendly team of anglers
whilst you browse the latest fishing tackle selection? Simply [**enter your location**][293] and
we'll show you the closest fishing stores in your area.

Many of our shops now offer fishing pole centres, bivvy and umbrella displays, and a selection of
bedchairs to try out. We even have a ‘Catchers Corner’ for you to sit, grab a coffee and discuss
local fishing venues!

Is it easy to learn to fish?

Angling Direct offers helpful resources and beginner tackle for your angling trips. Be sure to read
up on what [**Fishing Licence**][294] you may need from the Environment Agency.

If you want to learn new tips, whether you are a novice angler or seasoned, we have some great
fishing entertainment available on our [**Youtube Channel ADTV!**][295]

Our fishing videos offer anglers educational and insightful ways to catch some of the top fish
species in the UK as well as interesting interviews with professional anglers within the angling
community.

Get hooked on our fishing entertainment, starting with our ADTV video below!

# Welcome to our Online UK Fishing Tackle Store!

Whether you have just joined the world of fishing or have been angling for years, we share the same
love for this amazing pastime as you! That is why Angling Direct exists. We understand that fishing
is for all, without boundaries or restrictions, to purely enjoy the pursuit that angling offers.

That is why we want to help with **Getting Everyone Fishing.**

Here at Angling Direct, we are committed to providing you an incredible selection of the brands and
fishing tackle you love, fast and reliable delivery, and outstanding customer service. All whilst
giving the best price possible – With our **[Price Checker][286]**

We are here, for the Anglers

We have kept ahead of the game over the years by remaining constantly aware of the changing needs of
anglers, and we will continue to do so by always putting our customers' needs first.

Whether you are a beginner, novice, weekender, specialist, match winner, or syndicate member. We can
help you dream big with our fantastic selection of fishing tackle. Whatever your target species, or
ability and whether your fishing paradise is the beach, lake, canal, or river, you are in the right
hands with the UK’s No. 1 online fishing tackle shop!

We opened our first superstore back in 2004. We have since grown to provide [**Match & Coarse
Fishing**][287], [**Predator Fishing**][288], [**Specialist Fishing**][289], [**Fly Fishing**][290],
[**Sea Fishing**][291] tackle, and [**Carp Fishing**][292] tackle both in stores and online. Now,
you can shop for a variety of baits, fishing rods, fishing reels, fishing clothing, bait boats,
tackle boxes, fishing chairs, bite alarms, bed chairs for fishing, fishing lures, and more, all at
the most competitive prices.

Shop for Fishing Tackle In-Store!

Prefer to shop for your fishing gear in person or fancy a chat with our friendly team of anglers
whilst you browse the latest fishing tackle selection? Simply [**enter your location**][293] and
we'll show you the closest fishing stores in your area.

Many of our shops now offer fishing pole centres, bivvy and umbrella displays, and a selection of
bedchairs to try out. We even have a ‘Catchers Corner’ for you to sit, grab a coffee and discuss
local fishing venues!

Is it easy to learn to fish?

Angling Direct offers helpful resources and beginner tackle for your angling trips. Be sure to read
up on what [**Fishing Licence**][294] you may need from the Environment Agency.

If you want to learn new tips, whether you are a novice angler or seasoned, we have some great
fishing entertainment available on our [**Youtube Channel ADTV!**][295]

Our fishing videos offer anglers educational and insightful ways to catch some of the top fish
species in the UK as well as interesting interviews with professional anglers within the angling
community.

Get hooked on our fishing entertainment, starting with our ADTV video below!

## Who is GREENTIME

Ningbo Greentime Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd. is one member of the Sellers Union Group which is established
in 1997. We are a professional export agency of daily-use items, including kitchenware, cleaning
items, party supplies, home decoration, fitness, clothes accessories, and other general merchandise.

Our offices are located in Ningbo, Yiwu, Guangzhou and Shantou cities. Our sourcing teams will do
their best to wholesale or customize products at the most competitive prices.

We work with importers, wholesalers, e-commerce sellers, and retail chains across 200+ countries.
Our quality inspection follows AQL 2.5 standards, and every order ships with a full inspection
report before release.

MOQ starts from 500 units for most product categories. Sample orders are available before bulk
commitment.

## Technology

### The materials and technology on waterproof socks

#### Three Layers Construction

Our waterproof socks have three layers, the outer sock, the middle membrane and the inner sock.
Using our patented technology to take them together with seamless.

#### Lycra

LYCRA® fiber set the standard as the world's best-known elastane fiber brand. Lightweight and nearly
invisible. LYCRA® fiber let the socks have better fitting, durable, also delivery fit, shape and
comfort that lasts day after day, wash after wash, run after run.

#### Waterproof Membrane

The highly breathable waterproof membrane is very handy to realize the key waterproof features, keep
the feet dry and warm even in the terrible wet environments.

#### Merino Wool

The fine micron wool from Merino sheep. Merino wool's natural insulation and moisture management
properties make it easy to wear next to skin. Each fiber naturally helps regulate body temperature,
transports sweat away as a vapor and keep you protected in cold environments.

## Three-layer construction for dry comfort in wet conditions.

Technical waterproof products normally combine a durable outer layer, a breathable barrier membrane
and a comfort lining. This page frames those details in buyer language so distributors understand
the product value quickly.

**Outer layer** Nylon, polyester, merino blend or custom yarn package
**Waterproof membrane** Barrier layer for rain, puddles, snow and wet trail use
**Comfort lining** Coolmax, bamboo, merino, terry or warm seasonal lining

We pride ourselves in providing high-quality socks for various needs, from everyday wear to diabetic
socks. We are a unique sock manufacturer committed to making a difference in the world. Many of our
socks are made of renewable, recycled, and plant-based [materials][123] as we strive to positively
impact the environment and hold ourselves accountable for our role as a manufacturing corporation. 

## Eco-Friendly Innovations

Our roots can be traced back to 1988, when EcoSox was BBS Hosiery, specializing in manufacturing and
distributing products to various retailers. By 2008, the goals of manufacturing shifted to higher
standards of quality and performance that consumers valued. EcoSox was born from this shift, and we
began manufacturing with viscose derived from bamboo, an incredibly sustainable resource that made
our socks even better. 

EcoSox became our brand in 2008, and since then, we have dedicated ourselves to eco-friendly
innovations in making our socks that are:
* Soft and Comfortable
* Absorb 60% More Moisture Than Cotton
* Breathable for Moisture Evaporation 
* Biodegradable and Sustainable

## High-Quality For All

[EcoSox selection][124] has a range of high-quality socks, whether you're looking for diabetic socks
for men or athletic socks for women. [Shop by Activity][125] for eco-friendly running and biking
socks, outdoor, workforce, or active sports socks. Or, [Shop by Style][126] for low-profile, crew,
or over-the-calf socks. We offer diabetic socks for all activities in various styles. Our diabetic
socks for women and men provide comfort and support, so even with diabetes, edema, or neuropathy,
you can do what you love! We offer diabetic socks for all activities and in various styles. You
deserve comfort and quality–EcoSox does it both.

We pride ourselves in providing high-quality socks for various needs, from everyday wear to diabetic
socks. We are a unique sock manufacturer committed to making a difference in the world. Many of our
socks are made of renewable, recycled, and plant-based [materials][123] as we strive to positively
impact the environment and hold ourselves accountable for our role as a manufacturing corporation. 

## Eco-Friendly Innovations

Our roots can be traced back to 1988, when EcoSox was BBS Hosiery, specializing in manufacturing and
distributing products to various retailers. By 2008, the goals of manufacturing shifted to higher
standards of quality and performance that consumers valued. EcoSox was born from this shift, and we
began manufacturing with viscose derived from bamboo, an incredibly sustainable resource that made
our socks even better. 

EcoSox became our brand in 2008, and since then, we have dedicated ourselves to eco-friendly
innovations in making our socks that are:
* Soft and Comfortable
* Absorb 60% More Moisture Than Cotton
* Breathable for Moisture Evaporation 
* Biodegradable and Sustainable

## High-Quality For All

[EcoSox selection][124] has a range of high-quality socks, whether you're looking for diabetic socks
for men or athletic socks for women. [Shop by Activity][125] for eco-friendly running and biking
socks, outdoor, workforce, or active sports socks. Or, [Shop by Style][126] for low-profile, crew,
or over-the-calf socks. We offer diabetic socks for all activities in various styles. Our diabetic
socks for women and men provide comfort and support, so even with diabetes, edema, or neuropathy,
you can do what you love! We offer diabetic socks for all activities and in various styles. You
deserve comfort and quality–EcoSox does it both.

play video

Our vision is very clear to me. Everyone must trek, because I have seen how trekking can transform
lives.

But everyone must trek keeping safety in mind. Whether they trek with us or by themselves, they must
trek safely. There are no two ways about it. To do that, the safety systems of an organisation need
to be in place.

I know that Indiahikes is regarded across the country as India's safest trekking organisation. But
we are not sitting on it. Our entire team is working to see what the future of safety can be. And
this is an endless journey. Five years from now, you will hear me saying the same thing.

And that's how it must be. Safety cannot have a full stop. But what it can have is the quest to make
treks safer and safer. And that's how I see it.

**Arjun Majumdar**

The kaleidoscopic appearance and function performance of tie-dye socks are intriguing, yet simple.

[How Do Waterproof Socks Work?][221]

provides durability, the membrane prevents water from penetrating and the inner lining controls
sweat for comfort.

#### [ About Outdoor Life ][238]

*Outdoor Life* has been the go-to publication of America’s diehard hunters, shooters, and anglers
since 1898. Our stories are written by hunters, for hunters. We value experience in the field, at
the range, and on the water above all else. Our mission is to deliver stories about success in the
field, cutting-edge gear, and adventures in far-off wildernesses and close-to-home woodlots. We
inspire America’s outdoorsmen and women to chase the critters they’re passionate about and fight for
the wild places they love.

believes weather shouldn't keep people from riding, and we build gear to prove it. The outlets we're

### [Save 20% When You Support Indie Media][91]

**Independent media and independent brands have a lot in common.**

Showers Pass isn't backed by a conglomerate or VC dollars. We're a small Portland-based team that
believes weather shouldn't keep people from riding, and we build gear to prove it. The outlets we're
partnering with aren't backed by big money either. They're run by people who care deeply about
cycling and made a bet that readers would too. In these times of increasing consolidation, we think
it’s important to call out the value of your support for independent brands and media.

If you’re looking for ultimate performance in a cycling jacket, our Elite jackets are the clear
choice due to lighter weight, greater ventilation, and unmatched on-the-bike fit. 

If you’re looking for one jacket that can do it all but still has Showers Pass’s cycling heritage in
its DNA, the Refuge Jacket’s versatile cut and features make it a worthy companion for all your
trips on trail and in town.

## Super Knit Industries is one of India’s preeminent manufacturers
* Strong
  Foundation
* Quality
  Building

Super Knit Industries is a pioneer among socks manufactures in India. It is a premium quality socks
supplier, which has established a mark of its quality and excellence in the industry since the year
1999.

Recognized for exceptional quality, design innovation and customer satisfaction, Super Knit
Industries has an annual production capacity of 15,000,000 pairs of socks that are made with utmost
care and superior craftsmanship.

Super Knit Industries has a global outlook and surpasses the quality standards of socks
manufacturers from China. The company’s vision, its innovative design development, makes it a
frontrunner, among socks exporters in China and socks manufactures in Turkey. It has an exemplary
track record of customer satisfaction and stands out as one of the best exporters of socks in India.

## We are recognized for our Legacy, Diversity & Reliability

[Legacy]

#### Legacy

Our founder, Mr. Naval Saraf, has been a pioneer in the socks manufacturing business since 1973,
building a legacy of excellence over decades.
[Diversity]

#### Diversity

Our manpower is fully equipped to run machines ranging from 84N to 240N making socks for Men, Women,
Kids & Babies
[reliability]

#### Reliability

With our exemplary record of customer satisfaction, we are the most reliable socks suppliers to
consumers & brands across the world

## What We Do

#### Design

SKI's in-house design & sampling team is equipped to develop top quality designs & high precision
samples

#### Yarn

SKI procures the best quality yarns from top indian mills to ensures good product quality &
durability

#### Knit

SKI houses a range of world-class knitting machines & an experienced workforce to knit the finest
quality socks

#### Processing

SKI has a huge in-house capability for hand linking along with automatic linking of the toe end of
the socks

#### Pack & Dispatch

SKI houses automatic machines for barcode printing & packaging for finer finish & better shelf life
for the socks

## Our In House Brand

[supersox]
In 2012, the founder’s son’s, Mr. Harsh Saraf and Mr. Vivek Saraf joined the family business; they
realized its sheer potential and identified the gaps in India’s socks market and the lack of a
strong Indian brand for Quality Socks, Handkerchiefs & Boxers led to the inception of the in-house
brand – ‘Supersox’..

Super Knit is delighted to be able to directly reach their Indian consumers through Supersox. The
Indian consumers can now own and enjoy Super Knit Industries’ wide range of export quality socks
online through – www.supersox.in, a countrywide distributor network and local vendors.

## Sock Styles We Offer

A variety of premium sock styles to choose from to best suit your needs; with styles for on- and off
the field.

#### Premium Crew Socks

A favourite for a reason. Engineered for versatility and comfort. The perfect all-rounder for daily
wear, corporate branding, and any activity you can think of.

#### Ribbed Crew Socks

A stylish take on a classic. This sock features a distinctive texture and a relaxed fit, combining a
casual look with enhanced breathability for everyday comfort.

#### Casual Crew Socks

The ideal choice for high-quantity promotional gifting. Featuring a one-size-fits-most design and a
low-profile seamed toe for accessible comfort.

#### Anklet Socks

Sitting just above the ankle, this style is a firm favourite for running clubs, schools, and
athletic teams, offering a balance of coverage and freedom.

#### No-Show Tab Socks

A low-profile sock with a protective anti-slide tab at the heel to prevent blisters and slippage.
Provides discreet, all-day comfort.

#### Performance Knee-Highs

Premium Compression socks. Preferred  by runners, equestrian teams and field sport athletes. Now
with a certified Category D Compression rating.

#### Merino Wool Socks

Experience the natural performance of Merino wool. These socks provide superior temperature
regulation and moisture-wicking comfort, available in versatile crew or specialized ski designs.

#### Protective Arm Sleeves

Seamless, comfortable, and protective. Our arm sleeves offer CANSA-certified SPF 50+ UV resistance,
making them perfect for outdoor sports and activities.

#### Branded Sweatbands

A classic accessory for tennis, gym sessions, and events. Highly absorbent and features a prominent
branding area to showcase your logo.

  [What positive effects do toe socks have on foot health?]
  ][94]
  [ Dec02, 2024
  
  ### What positive effects do toe socks have on foot health?
  
  1. Promote blood circulation and comfort in the feetThe design of five-finger socks allows each
  toe to move independently without limiting its range of motion due to the close connection of the
  toes. This separated design helps blood circulation in the feet. Traditional socks usually
  compress the toes and restrict the natural movement between the toes, while five-finger socks
  allow the toes to separate and move freely, thereby improving blood flow and avoiding swelling or
  discomfort in the feet due to long-term compression. Especially for people who stand or walk for a
  long time, wearing five-finger socks can effectively relieve foot fatigue and edema caused by poor
  blood circulation. 2. Reduce toe friction and the formation of blistersFriction between toes is a
  common problem when wearing socks and shoes, especially tight shoes and non-breathable socks will
  aggravate this problem. Long-term friction not only makes people feel uncomfortable, but also
  leads to the formation of blisters in severe cases. The design of five-finger socks can
  effectively avoid direct friction between toes. Each toe has an independent space, which reduces
  the contact between shoes and socks and toes. This can effectively reduce skin damage caused by
  friction, especially during exercise, which can effectively prevent the occurrence of blisters. 3.
  Promote foot hygiene and reduce athlete's foot and foot odorAnother significant advantage of
  five-finger socks is that they help keep feet dry and clean. Traditional socks tie the toes
  together, which easily leads to sweat accumulation between the toes, causing moisture and
  bacterial growth. Five-finger socks, by separating the toes, allow each toe to have sufficient air
  circulation space, which can effectively reduce moisture in the feet, keep the feet dry, and avoid
  the growth of bacteria and fungi, thereby reducing the occurrence of athlete's foot, foot odor and
  other problems.The design of five-finger socks helps to improve the breathability of the feet.
  Most five-finger socks are made of natural or highly breathable materials, such as cotton, wool,
  bamboo fiber, etc. These materials can help the feet sweat better and reduce the occurrence of
  athlete's foot. For some people who are prone to foot odor, wearing five-finger socks can not only
  improve the hygiene of the feet, but also improve the comfort of daily wear. 4. Improve sports
  performanceFor athletes or people who exercise regularly, five-finger socks can significantly
  improve sports performance. During exercise, friction between the toes and limited movement of the
  feet will affect the smoothness and comfort of exercise. The design of five-finger socks can help
  each toe move more flexibly and avoid friction and discomfort between toes. In addition, the
  material of five-finger socks usually has good moisture-wicking properties, which can help
  athletes keep their feet dry and reduce skin discomfort caused by moisture and excessive friction,
  thereby improving the durability and comfort of exercise.Especially in sports such as running,
  hiking and cycling, five-finger socks can provide better support and stability for the toes and
  reduce sports injuries caused by friction and discomfort. The design of many running shoes and
  sports shoes often cannot fully adapt to the shape of the foot, and the design of five-finger
  socks can complement sports shoes, so that each toe can get better comfort and support. 5. Prevent
  interdigital skin diseasesThe design of five-finger socks helps reduce contact between toes, avoid
  moisture and bacterial accumulation, and is an effective measure to prevent interdigital skin
  diseases. The space between toes is prone to become a hotbed for the growth of bacteria and fungi,
  especially for people who sweat easily. The humid environment is more likely to cause skin
  diseases such as athlete's foot and toe ringworm. After putting on five-toe socks, the toes are
  fully separated and breathable, making it difficult for bacteria and fungi to grow, thereby
  effectively preventing foot skin diseases.

  [What positive effects do toe socks have on foot health?]
  ][94]
  [ Dec02, 2024
  
  ### What positive effects do toe socks have on foot health?
  
  1. Promote blood circulation and comfort in the feetThe design of five-finger socks allows each
  toe to move independently without limiting its range of motion due to the close connection of the
  toes. This separated design helps blood circulation in the feet. Traditional socks usually
  compress the toes and restrict the natural movement between the toes, while five-finger socks
  allow the toes to separate and move freely, thereby improving blood flow and avoiding swelling or
  discomfort in the feet due to long-term compression. Especially for people who stand or walk for a
  long time, wearing five-finger socks can effectively relieve foot fatigue and edema caused by poor
  blood circulation. 2. Reduce toe friction and the formation of blistersFriction between toes is a
  common problem when wearing socks and shoes, especially tight shoes and non-breathable socks will
  aggravate this problem. Long-term friction not only makes people feel uncomfortable, but also
  leads to the formation of blisters in severe cases. The design of five-finger socks can
  effectively avoid direct friction between toes. Each toe has an independent space, which reduces
  the contact between shoes and socks and toes. This can effectively reduce skin damage caused by
  friction, especially during exercise, which can effectively prevent the occurrence of blisters. 3.
  Promote foot hygiene and reduce athlete's foot and foot odorAnother significant advantage of
  five-finger socks is that they help keep feet dry and clean. Traditional socks tie the toes
  together, which easily leads to sweat accumulation between the toes, causing moisture and
  bacterial growth. Five-finger socks, by separating the toes, allow each toe to have sufficient air
  circulation space, which can effectively reduce moisture in the feet, keep the feet dry, and avoid
  the growth of bacteria and fungi, thereby reducing the occurrence of athlete's foot, foot odor and
  other problems.The design of five-finger socks helps to improve the breathability of the feet.
  Most five-finger socks are made of natural or highly breathable materials, such as cotton, wool,
  bamboo fiber, etc. These materials can help the feet sweat better and reduce the occurrence of
  athlete's foot. For some people who are prone to foot odor, wearing five-finger socks can not only
  improve the hygiene of the feet, but also improve the comfort of daily wear. 4. Improve sports
  performanceFor athletes or people who exercise regularly, five-finger socks can significantly
  improve sports performance. During exercise, friction between the toes and limited movement of the
  feet will affect the smoothness and comfort of exercise. The design of five-finger socks can help
  each toe move more flexibly and avoid friction and discomfort between toes. In addition, the
  material of five-finger socks usually has good moisture-wicking properties, which can help
  athletes keep their feet dry and reduce skin discomfort caused by moisture and excessive friction,
  thereby improving the durability and comfort of exercise.Especially in sports such as running,
  hiking and cycling, five-finger socks can provide better support and stability for the toes and
  reduce sports injuries caused by friction and discomfort. The design of many running shoes and
  sports shoes often cannot fully adapt to the shape of the foot, and the design of five-finger
  socks can complement sports shoes, so that each toe can get better comfort and support. 5. Prevent
  interdigital skin diseasesThe design of five-finger socks helps reduce contact between toes, avoid
  moisture and bacterial accumulation, and is an effective measure to prevent interdigital skin
  diseases. The space between toes is prone to become a hotbed for the growth of bacteria and fungi,
  especially for people who sweat easily. The humid environment is more likely to cause skin
  diseases such as athlete's foot and toe ringworm. After putting on five-toe socks, the toes are
  fully separated and breathable, making it difficult for bacteria and fungi to grow, thereby
  effectively preventing foot skin diseases.
